Synopsis:
The player approaches a goblin camp. Three goblins and a yena are huddled around a campfire, warily watching the shifting shadows. As you step into the light, one of the goblins steps forward to greet you. You can ask him about the shadowy environs, and he will demonstrate the shadow-curse by killing the hyena.

Cluster Contexts:
- SCL_DriderCaravan_GoblinMelee_001_Checkpoint.json: You're standing at a small goblin camp of three goblins and a hyena around a fire in an area of shifting, dangerous shadow. One goblin, Warrior Gronag, deliberately throws a bone into the dark to demonstrate the local shadow-curse; the hyena runs after it and is killed out of sight (you only hear the growl, yelp and crunch). Gronag recognizes or assumes you’re the "True Soul" who needs passage to Moonrise and, while initially wary and armed, directs you to talk to Kansif inside. Off-screen factors — your companions, past choices, reputation, or quest progress — may affect how much the goblins trust or fear you and which dialogue or actions are available.
- SCL_Hyena.json: This hyena is full grown but acts more like a pup. He was raised by the goblins and tries his best to make them love him, but he is tormented by them constantly. He desperately wishes to flee but lacks the courage. Player can encourage him to stay or convince him to leave.
- SCL_Hyena_AD_CaravanLeaves.json: Hyena runs away and goblin reacts to it.
- MOO_KethericHound_Hound_SwA.json: The players encounters Ketheric's undead hound in his chambers while sneaking around the tower. She's territorial - but if she smells Isobel's blessing on us she'll recognise Selunite magic. She reveals that she misses the way her master used to be.
- CAMP_GoblinHuntCelebration_CourierDog.json: Courier dog's dialog during the goblin hunt celebration party. The camp will be full of either tieflings or goblins. If the tieflings are present, Scratch is excited and playful; if the goblins are present, he's scared and anxious.

context: You come upon a small goblin camp of three goblins and a hyena gathered around a fire in an area of shifting, dangerous shadow. Warrior Gronag deliberately demonstrates the local shadow-curse by tossing a bone into the darkness; the hyena (a full-grown but pup‑like animal raised and tormented by the goblins) chases it and is killed off‑screen — you only hear a growl, a yelp and a sickening crunch. Gronag assumes you’re the “True Soul” who needs passage to Moonrise and, while initially wary and armed, relaxes and tells you to speak with Kansif inside. Off‑screen factors — your companions, past choices, reputation, or quest progress — may affect how much the goblins trust or fear you and which dialogue/actions are available.
